about: Ask for your issuance fees back when a service was not completed.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For a service that was not completed
Only issuance fees are refundable; application and smart service fees are not
documents: Bank certificate showing your account number and IBAN
fees: The refundable amount is shown on the service receipt
timing: An accepted refund is transferred to the bank account straight away
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
